audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 3 read Skill / Yone / Yone in both layers while the packet chart gives Volibear on all three. The whys beside them already said 'Level 2 stays yours', 'At 3 your full Q-W-E combo out-trades his kit' and 'Levels 4-5 you keep the edge' — so three rows printed a side token contradicting their own explanation, and phases[2].why and phases[3].why described a Volibear kill window under a Yone banner.
audit.why: Levels 2-5 are Volibear's on cooldowns: Thundering Smash (12s rank 1) plus Frenzied Maul (5s) against a Yone whose Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and whose Mortal Steel knockup needs two stacks. He has no reliable escape from a landed stun until E's cooldown falls. Rows 5 and 6 correctly stay Yone.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 3 set to Volibear in both layers as one atomic group, ratings raised to 6/10, 7/10 and 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why told you to run Yone down 'every time Soul Unbound is on cooldown' without saying how long that window is — the packet's own defect class of unactionable sequencing advice.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s. At the levels this row covers it is a 19-16s gap, which is long enough to walk him down twice; by two items it is 10s and the same advice stops being true. The number is what makes the instruction usable.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why now carries the 19s rank-2 figure and keys the walk-down to that gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's Q is called a slow in five fields (whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text, content.early, content.mid), and spikes[1].text says Fate Sealed 'knocks up'.
audit.why: Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) stuns — the slow in Volibear's kit belongs to Sky Splitter (E) and Stormbringer (R). Against Yone this matters exactly because a slow would not stop Mortal Steel's dash or the Soul Unbound snap-back, and a stun does. Fate Sealed is described by Riot as a blink behind the last champion in a line that pulls everyone hit toward him — a displacement pull, not a knockup; the kit carries no knockup flag on his R, only on Mortal Steel at two stacks.
audit.corrected: All five Q references now say stun (whys[2] keeps its slow, correctly reattributed to E); spikes[1].text now describes Fate Sealed as a blink-behind that pulls everyone hit in.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Yone down every time Soul Unbound is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Soul Unbound is 19s at rank 2 — run him down inside that gap and you win the stat-check to 6.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is yours with a stronger stat block and Q slow before Yone's combo comes online.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is yours with a stronger stat block and the Q stun before Yone's combo comes online.

edits.before: At 3 your full Q-W-E combo out-trades his kit and holds him with the slow.
edits.after: At 3 your full Q-W-E combo out-trades his kit and holds him with E's slow.

edits.before: Your Q slow into W Frenzied Maul and E Sky Splitter out-trade Yone before his Q2 knockup is reliable; if he throws his Q dash-strike to poke, walk him down with Q while his gap-closer is on cooldown.
edits.after: Your Q stun into W Frenzied Maul and E Sky Splitter out-trade Yone before his Q2 knockup is reliable; if he throws his Q dash-strike to poke, walk him down with Q while his gap-closer is on cooldown.

edits.before: Yone's R Fate Sealed knocks up and dashes through your line for a hard all-in, and it comes online same time as yours; your R can answer, but this is where his kill pressure jumps, so respect his ult plus jungle.
edits.after: Yone's R Fate Sealed blinks behind your line and pulls everyone hit in for a hard all-in, and it comes online same time as yours; your R can answer, but this is where his kill pressure jumps, so respect his ult.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours: your stat block and Q slow beat Yone's early poke, which leans on his Q dash and stacking his passive crit. Punish him each time he steps up to farm before his combo is fully online.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: your stat block and the Q stun beat Yone's early poke, which leans on his Q dash and stacking his passive crit. Punish him each time he steps up to farm before his combo is online.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay in your favour because your Q-W-E combo out-trades his single windwall-less kit, and he can't safely dash on you while your Q slow holds him. Keep pressuring whenever his Q2 and E are down so he can't rewind out clean.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay in your favour because your Q-W-E combo out-trades his single windwall-less kit, and he can't safely dash on you while your Q stun holds him. Keep pressuring whenever his Q2 and E are down so he can't rewind out clean.

notes: Three chart rows were desynced from the packet and from their own why text and are now proposed as matched pairs. Two ability errors fixed: Volibear's Q was called a slow in five fields (it stuns — Sky Splitter and Stormbringer are the slows), and Fate Sealed was described as a knockup when Riot's text has it blink behind the last champion in a line and pull everyone hit toward him. Whether the Soul Unbound snap-back can be interrupted mid-flight, and whether tenacity shortens Thundering Smash's stun enough to matter here, are not in Riot's text and I asserted neither.
